CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_revenue_data(p_today timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN (
    SELECT json_build_object(
      'total_revenue',    COALESCE((SELECT sum(final_amount) FROM public.payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid'), 0),
      'today_revenue',    COALESCE((SELECT sum(final_amount) FROM public.payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid' AND created_at >= p_today), 0),
      'total_commission', COALESCE((SELECT sum(COALESCE(final_amount, 0) - COALESCE(rider_earning, 0)) FROM public.payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid'), 0),
      'total_payout',     COALESCE((SELECT sum(rider_earning) FROM public.payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid'), 0),
      'total_rides',      COALESCE((SELECT count(*) FROM public.orders WHERE order_status IN ('completed', 'delivered')), 0),
      'total_collection', COALESCE((SELECT sum(final_amount) FROM public.payments WHERE payment_status = 'paid'), 0),
      'total_gst',        COALESCE((SELECT sum(gst_amount) FROM public.orders WHERE order_status IN ('completed', 'delivered')), 0),
      'type_breakdown',   COALESCE((
        SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(t) ORDER BY t.revenue DESC)
        FROM (
          SELECT
            COALESCE(order_type::text, 'unknown')                      AS type,
            sum(COALESCE(NULLIF(final_fare, 0), actual_fare, 0))       AS revenue,
            count(*)                                                   AS orders
          FROM public.orders
          WHERE order_status IN ('completed', 'delivered')
          GROUP BY COALESCE(order_type::text, 'unknown')
        ) t
      ), '[]'::json)
    )
  );
END;
$function$
